messages:
Jules: FYI - NA-west GPU pool (us-west2) is showing high mem pressure and queue depth. Pod restarts + kernel OOMs for a few VMs. Telemetry: 95% GPU mem, queues at 70%. GSLB still sending ~45% traffic to us-west2. Suggest throttling and gradual shift to na-east and eu-west. Anyone on it?
Carlos: On it. Seeing a burst on p3/p4 pools. Symptoms match NVLink flapping we've seen before. No capacity failure yet but latency SLOs are degrading.
Nina: Is autoscaler failing to add instances or are VMs unhealthy? I can check ASG and kube events.
Carlos: ASG trying to spin but some VMs go into provisioning loop (initd timeout). Kube nodes not joining. Suspect image/boot timeout after kernel patch.
Jules: We should avoid a hard cutover -> do weighted shift with short TTL so sessions drain. Plan: reduce us-west2 weight to 10% over 3 steps, add 20% to na-east and 25% to eu-west. Keep warm pools for edge cases.
Ben: +1. Also enable prefix cache on na-east for hot models to avoid cold KV fetch penalty.
sre-bot: Alert: region-us-west2 GPU pool error rate increased 4x in last 5m. Auto-backoff policy triggered for model-serving route "/v1/generate-large" - rolling fallback engaged.
Carlos: Command I'll run (dry run first):
```
curl -X POST https://gslb.internal/api/v1/weights \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region_weights":{"us-west2":10,"na-east":35,"eu-west":40,"ap-south":15}}'
```
Do we want ap-south as spill or keep it minimal?
Nina: Keep ap-south minimal (10-15) to avoid cross-continent latency for interactive traffic. Use ap-south for batch/embeddings if needed.
Jules: Make it gradual: step1 set us-west2=30, na-east=30, eu-west=30, ap-south=10; wait 90s; then us-west2=15; wait 90s; then us-west2=10. Monitor queue depth and tail latency.
Ben: Add health-check override to temporarily mark nodes in us-west2 as DRY_RUN so we don't accidentally evacuate warm caches. Also ORCA: set route fallback to model-smaller if GPU errors persist.
Carlos: Executing step1 now (dry run flag false).
ops-oncall: gslb-change: user=Carlos action=apply step=1 payload={"us-west2":30,"na-east":30,"eu-west":30,"ap-south":10} status=ok duration=12s :rocket:
Jules: Good. Watch token-level latency and per-route errors in console. If tail > 1.2s or GPU OOMs continue, escalate to full evacuate.
Nina: ASG logs show a flaky kernel module on images built 2026-03-02. Spinning a new image with rollback to 2026-02-20. That should fix node joins in ~10m.
Carlos: If nodes start rejoining, we should ramp weights back slowly. Set a cooldown: min 5m between adjustments.
Ben: Cost note: shifting to eu-west increases egress and cross-region cost by ~12% for this route. I'll open a quick ticket but prioritize stability.
Jules: Agree on stability. After region stabilized, we'll run a postmortem and cost/placement follow-up. For now, continue monitoring.
sre-bot: metrics: us-west2 queue_depth=22 -> 11 after step1, gpu_ooms=6->2, tail_latency_p95 1.45s -> 1.1s
Carlos: Proceeding step2 in 45s if metrics continue to improve.
Nina: Noted. I'll watch node pool rebuild and notify when nodes rejoin.
Ben: Thanks all. Quick FYI for apps: update client routing TTL to 15s for faster convergence during this incident.
Jules: Thanks. If anything regresses, ping @ops-oncall and we'll revert weights to last-known-good. :thumbsup:
